# Play — Pinwheel Whispers

- SudokuPad: [Pinwheel Whispers on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Pinwheel Whispers on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Keypad / whisper lines are exported as generic coloured lines; read the rules text for their meaning.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (givens, constraints, solution).
